intro: Lesson 30: Important Lessons unit 1: the last three surahs. Plan or write in each box.

parts.text: Point 1: Allah is One (112:1). Develop: no partner in His lordship or worship. Point 2: He has no parent or child and none is equal to Him (112:3-4). Develop: this rejects any idea of Allah being like creation.
